time_semantics: Each table5 Time value is the lifetime/duration of that evolutionary phase; cumulative stellar age is the ordered sum of phase lifetimes.
mass_semantics: At each phase endpoint, cumulative wind mass lost is initial_mass minus table5 total_mass.
duplicate_policy: Collapse an exactly identical repeated phase row once; fail closed if any repeated coordinate has different physical values.

integrated_wind_comparison.initial_mass_msun_le_25: sum all table9 isotopic wind ejecta
integrated_wind_comparison.initial_mass_msun_gt_25: sum all table8 recommended-set-R isotopic ejecta, which the source defines as wind only

required_before_approval: Reconcile phase-endpoint mass loss with the integrated isotopic wind table at source precision.
Provide or approve a time-resolved wind composition model rather than scaling one terminal composition over all phases.
Select the rotation distribution and interpolation policy.
Cross-calibrate the source with the low/intermediate-mass wind and AGB source.
